edits.new:
| Integration dependencies | rwb-source-data (P1) data product contract for the masked read of v_ace_customer and v_ace_contact; the suite asserts the masking through P4 and P1 |
| Cache and failure rule | Cached permission and masking data is refreshed on AccessPolicyChanged and DoaLimitChanged and on the 5 minute membership refresh under DL38; the cache lifetime is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0161); when rwb-access does not answer the service refuses the action (deny by default, fail closed) |
| Partner roles | PT role rows (PT-AGENCY, PT-LAWFIRM, PT-VALUER, PT-AUCTION, PT-BUYER, PT-RAMC, PT-LED), their letters and their default scope stay with P4; the partner user record, the instruction and the result stay with S9, which calls POST /authorise with the PT role code and holds the user-to-role link (GAP-0164) |
| OCR and field text | The classification of document_text.text_content and document_field.field_value is left to the data steward (GAP-0262); the OCR text and the field value never appear in an event, a workflow input or a log, and the page id appears only in a log |
| Permission matrix count | 756 rows at 54 roles; the row count of a version is taken from the approved file, and the roster grows to 54 by go-live (GAP-0778) |
| Masking-policy read | GET /api/recovery/access/v1/masking-policies (Reference data R); the policy decides clear or masked, and the data owner supplies the masked or last-four value (GAP-0778, GAP-1405) |
| Policy event | rwb.access.AccessPolicyChanged.v1 carries the change kind, the version label and the effective date, and no value (GAP-0778) |
| Baseline and test fakes | The rwb_access baseline is the service template's V0001; the rwb-case case contract fake is the mock of the criteria (GAP-0778) |
| Library artefact | Platform coordinate with major version 1; the coordinate is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1404) |
| Cache time to live | Held in a parameter read through the parameters client; the value and the parameter key are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1404) |
| Authorise and masking payloads | POST /authorise takes role, scope and DoA; the masking policy decides clear or masked and the data owner supplies the masked or last-four value; the three payload shapes are recorded at the contract freeze (GAP-1404) |
| Interfaces and annotation | The guard, scope guard and mask applier are published with their types, and the personal-data annotation with its field-id attribute; the types are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1405) |
| Access audit record | Case id, field id and the flag clear or masked; the four shapes are recorded at the contract freeze (GAP-1405) |
| Access-owner failure | Every access-owner failure maps to 503 with no business data (GAP-1405) |
| Masking answer | Per-role row; marker values clear and masked; last-four shape; masking version; field names fixed at the RWB-P4-E1037-CON contract review (GAP-0915) |
| Authorise envelope | Request and answer carry area, right, scope, resource, filter, rowCount and matrixVersion; the three answers are allow, refuse by right and refuse by scope; field names and codes fixed at the wave 2 contract review (GAP-0925) |
